entities.name: Ovambo Settlement in Northern Namibia
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Ovambo-speaking peoples settle in the well-watered Cuvelai drainage system (Owamboland); develop mixed farming economy; become the largest ethnic group in Namibia.
